How to pair with my TV

1. On the TV: Settings → Connection → External Device Manager → Input Device Manager → Bluetooth Device List (or Settings → Sound → Bluetooth Device List on some models).

2. In PocketPad: tap “Make phone discoverable”.

3. On the TV, select the device named after your phone and confirm pairing on both screens.

4. Once paired, the TV connects to PocketPad as a gamepad. Next time, use “Connect to a paired device” to reconnect instantly.

PS3 controller: plug it into the phone with a USB‑C OTG adapter. PocketPad will detect it automatically and forward its buttons and sticks to the TV alongside the touch controls.
